The workflows are on `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"? Local verification:

- `bundle exec rake` — green: 2520 runs, 0 failures; internal RuboCop clean (142 files, no offenses); changelog/doc checks pass.
- The three new "does not correct" assertions (`assert`/`refute` variants of the #310 repro, plus the `assert_operator`/`refute_operator` ambiguous forms) fail on `master` — they show the old wrong-order autocorrect.
@koic friendly ping: rebased on current main; the workflows still need "Approve and run" to start. Happy to adjust if you'd prefer a different approach, as with #366.
Friendly ping: this is ready for review whenever someone has a moment. Happy to adjust anything.
